title: WE GLORY IN YOUR NAME BY CHOOKAR AND LOVEWORLD SINGERS

slides.label: Verse 1
lines: The weapons of our warfare are not carnal
They are mighty through You
to pull down strongholds
To cast down imaginations in Your name

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: And bring every thought under subjection
That exalts itself above Your Word
To surrender and bow in honour of Your name

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Just the thought of the power of Your name
and how far it stands above every other name
Brings to light the extent of the power
You gave to us
It has no limits and nothing to compare

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: We glory in Your name, Lord Jesus
Name above all other names
In Your name, we always win ‘n’ conquer
We glory in Your name, Lord Jesus
Not in the wisdom of men
In Your name, we proclaim peace to the nations

slides.label: Verse 6
lines: With our lions fastened with truth
And well fitted on us, the breastplate
of Your righteousness
We take the Gospel of peace all over the world

slides.label: Verse 7
lines: And above all, with the shield of faith
We extinguish the fiery darts
Of the deceitful one
All these we do in Your name
